description: Create a Stripe coupon: exactly one of percentOff (1–100) or amountOff (major units) + currency; duration once (default), repeating (with durationInMonths) or forever; optional name, id and maxRedemptions. A coupon alone has NO code a customer can type: pass `code` (letters, digits, dashes) to also mint the customer-typable promotion code in the same call, with optional codeMaxRedemptions, expiresAt, firstTimeOnly and minimumAmount. Read back. LIVE key: confirm:true after showing the preview. Needs Stripe connected (Settings > Connectors > Stripe, or connect_connector).

amountOff.description: fixed discount in major units, e.g. 5 = 5.00; needs currency

code.description: the customer-typable promotion code, e.g. SUMMER20 — letters, digits and dashes only; refused (never altered) otherwise

confirm.description: true on a live key, after the user approves the preview

durationInMonths.description: months the discount applies, with duration repeating

firstTimeOnly.description: the code works only on a customer's first purchase

id.description: custom coupon id; Stripe generates one if omitted

maxRedemptions.description: uses of the COUPON across every code

minimumAmount.description: minimum order in MAJOR units for the code

minimumAmountCurrency.description: currency for the code's minimumAmount, e.g. usd

name.description: display name for the coupon, for your records

percentOff.description: percent discount, 1 to 100; use this or amountOff

name: create_stripe_coupon
title: create stripe coupon
